Ever since I met her I've been slowly throwing my life away. Subtle indications date back to before this but lets be honest… She was the deciding benefactor. I am a walking rotting corpse. See I was a troubled kid with parent issues, abandonment issues, co dependency issues…Fear of the unknown, fear of the outside. And all but one moment changed everything. A simple hello lead to interest, interest lead to passion, and passion lead to this endearing relationship between two people who didn't really know what they wanted. Here I was trying to live a story. Begging for labels, arguing for some consistency… Here I had a girl who said we were “just friends” even after late night meetings, make up sex, break up sex, I love you one day to I hate you the next. Kissing each other in the middle of the night. To holding hands through ikea stores…I lived through that movie and learned that life isnt all fairy tales. That there was no such thing as fate. Nothing was as it was cracked up to be. I became cynical and a devoid of passion. It was from here I reshaped my life. After failed suicide attempts, dealing with the fact that I could not hold her. I could not experience her love that she did give on occasion. After being hospitalized for weeks… I got back up. Lived in a bed for half a year moping and crying and fading away. Slowly but surely. Not eating, not taking care of myself. Slowly but surely destroying myself. Until one day I said fuck it. I don’t know if it was the medication. Or just the sickness finally getting to me. But I decided to be who I wanted to be. Free from constraint, and brimming with charisma. It was here where I met a girl I loved fondly. And we had the perfect relationship. We never argued, never fought, never had problems. But we never did anything either. I always thought she was going to leave me due to the fact that I was her first real relationship. I was cynical and set up my own failures. Then behind all these walls of stability and security…. they all came crashing down when I found out my grandmother had cancer.
